# Vendored Vox evaluator

Unmodified runtime sources from https://github.com/RayZh-hs/Vox, revision
`1d028fac2a6d30e642208a3e5bbc6db43019e0a4`. This revision includes the fixed-width
integers required by Flow graphs. Only the three runtime crates are included;
dev-only dependencies and workspace members are omitted. Licenses are retained.
Update deliberately with graph/type regression coverage. No sibling checkout is needed.
